text: Now abuse . Shrink half, pad window chrome like screenshot, push JPEG quality 50: tf_resize(), tf_pad() tf_jpeg() image transforms package’s stress-test suite.
code: library(ggplot2) library(watermark)  p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) +   geom_point() +   watermark_dots("RUN-42")          # just another + component  file <- tempfile(fileext = ".png") ggsave(file, p, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 150)  extract_watermark(file) #> [1] "RUN-42" img <- png::readPNG(file) abused <- tf_jpeg(tf_pad(tf_resize(img, 0.5), 40), quality = 50)  extract_watermark(abused) #> [1] "RUN-42"

text: dot position one bit; dot means 1, gap means 0. frame : Start sync, 1010…: eight evenly spaced dots. decoder uses lock measure pitch, doesn’t care image size. Length byte, payload (ID’s UTF-8 bytes). CRC-8 length payload. End sync, …0101. frame’s first last bits 1, outermost dots mark frame edges. Decoding scans every row image. one compares pixels local neighbourhood (borders UI chrome don’t confuse ), finds start sync, samples bit position, accepts row syncs, length checksum agree. 40 check bits, decode exact NULL: doesn’t guess.

watermark 0.1.0
text: First release. watermark_dots() adds invisible, machine-readable ID along plot’s bottom margin ordinary + component. drawn relative figure, scales, coordinates facets untouched, framed sync patterns CRC-8 decodes exact rejected. extract_watermark() reads ID back PNG JPEG files, pixel arrays. survives JPEG compression, rescaling, padding, colour changes screenshot chains; see robustness matrix README. watermark_text() adds visible stamps: diagonal “DRAFT”, repeating tile, corner label. Text stays clear dot strip. ggsave_watermark() saves dots writes provenance fields PNG metadata; read_watermark_metadata() reads back. wm_id() wm_uuid() generate IDs private random stream neither affects affected set.seed().
